title: Add clickable WhatsApp chat button and update contact details (phone + email)

requirements.text: Update the consultation/contact section to display the provided phone number and email address, replacing the current placeholder phone number and existing email text.

quotes: PHONE NUMBER / WHATSAPP NUMBER =  +91 8780410844  EMAIL ID  freelancingdurg@gmail.com

acceptanceCriteria: In the consultation section contact cards, the phone number is shown as "+91 8780410844" (no placeholders like "+91 XXX XXX XXXX").
In the consultation section contact cards, the email is shown as "freelancingdurg@gmail.com" (replacing any existing email such as "hello@webraft.in").
All user-facing text remains in English.

requirements.text: Add a clickable WhatsApp CTA button that opens a direct WhatsApp chat to the number 918780410844 using a standard WhatsApp deep link, so users can click and start chatting immediately.

quotes: and add whatsapp button so user can click and directly chat with me on 918780410844

acceptanceCriteria: A visible WhatsApp button exists on the site and is clearly labeled for WhatsApp chat.
Clicking the WhatsApp button opens a WhatsApp chat link targeting phone number "918780410844" (e.g., https://wa.me/918780410844).
The link opens in a new tab/window (or otherwise does not break the current browsing session) and works on both desktop and mobile browsers.

requirements.text: Make the WhatsApp contact area in the consultation/contact section actionable by linking it to the same WhatsApp direct chat URL for 918780410844.

quotes: add whatsapp button so user can click and directly chat with me on 918780410844

acceptanceCriteria: The WhatsApp card/row in the consultation section is clickable (or contains a button/link) that opens https://wa.me/918780410844.
No backend changes are required for this interaction.

requirements.text: Update the site footer contact area to include the provided phone number and email address (and optionally include a WhatsApp chat link) so the contact details are visible outside the consultation section as well.

quotes: PHONE NUMBER / WHATSAPP NUMBER =  +91 8780410844  EMAIL ID  freelancingdurg@gmail.com

acceptanceCriteria: If a WhatsApp link is included in the footer, it points to https://wa.me/918780410844.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing UI components instead).
Do not require any backend persistence or backend API calls for WhatsApp/contact interactions.
nonGoals: Implementing a backend-powered contact form submission or email sending.
Adding third-party chat widgets, analytics, or WhatsApp Business API integrations.
